column3: “Gateway” renders plural entrances; coasts renders islands.
“Coasts of Cyprus” specifies the islands of Kittim; the wood species is not explicit.
The separate wise men of Gebal are not retained; coming alongside specifies being in her.
“On your walls” specifies in you; shields and helmets render singular shield and helmet.
“Helech” renders your army as a name.
“Paid you” renders returning tribute; coastlands renders islands.
“From Zahar” renders white as a place name.
“Casks of wine from Izal” replaces Dan and Javan from Uzal.
Gold is placed before spices and stones.
“Heavy cargo” identifies the filling and becoming heavy.
“Sink” specifies fall; on board specifies in you.
